title: Bounded cohomology turns power torsion into rational vanishing
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $X$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $C\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], viewed in the derived category of sheaves of modules over the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $u,v\in\mathbf Z$ with $u\leq v$, and let $N\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$. If $H^d(C)=0$ for $d\notin[u,v]$ and $\varpi_E^N H^d(C)=0$ for every $d$, then $\varpi_E^{N(v-u+2)}\operatorname{id}_C=0$ in that derived category. Consequently the image of $C$ in $D^b_c(X,E)=D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] is zero.
